stock_only.scope: Stock-only failed-restored attempt; no compressed timed requests

worker_traces.ownership_method: Device correlation ID -> CUDA runtime/driver call -> containing CPU model annotation, same PID/TID
limits: Only the profiler's retained active window is analyzed; later request forwards may be absent.
Kernel duration sums are not wall time, measured memory traffic or a TP critical path.
A graph kernel span covers its first-to-last kernel, not the complete request or all copies.
Unassigned kernels remain explicit; no nearest-time attribution or missing-event extrapolation.

stock_profile_kernel_groups.scope: Stock-only pure decode main compute-stream ranges containing all 84 expert kernels; C16 selects actual tokens >8, C8 selects actual tokens 5..8. Only retained active windows.
limits: Kernel groups use names and are not measured memory traffic.
Main-stream spans and sums are not request latency or a TP critical path.
Uncovered stream intervals include dependencies/copies/instrumentation; they are not a measurement of CPU kernel-launch overhead.
No compressed results or same-time paired stock control.
